description: The address a payment to a name (or a 0x address) reaches on one network, from the name's verified on-chain records. Use this right before paying, with the network you will pay on.

network.description: Network code from list_networks, such as ETH, BASE, SOL or BTC. Omit for the name's main network

to.description: The name or 0x address to pay

name: get_payment_address
title: Get a payment address
